note.en: Chartered by the Banking and Commercial Currency Act 1993. Holds the treasury and payroll accounts of the Government of the ISEZ and the export escrow accounts audited by the Irad Foreign Trade Escrow Authority. Dollar and som accounts; SMS payments.
